sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash - SGLang Documentation
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is a natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model built around a hybrid attention architecture — 320B total parameters with 18B active. Its 45 text layers combine MLA attention, DSA sparse attention, and KDA linear attention, and a 24-layer vision encoder handles image and video input.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash: How to Run Locally - unsloth.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash can now run locally in Unsloth Desktop! GLM-5.3-Flash was trained on 30T tokens and is built on a newly trained base model redesigned. Its hybrid sparse and linear attention architecture lowers long-context serving costs without sacrificing accuracy, while Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections improve scaling.
